card: This PR adds unit tests verifying the error detection and location bounds of Bech32 checksums at both the standard 90-character limit and the 1023-character silent payments limit. It also updates code comments to clarify that checksums guarantee detecting up to N character changes rather than locating or fixing them. The change addresses missing test coverage for the newer silent payments character limit identified by the author.
evidence: PR description: 'Initially I was just looking at all code around Silent Payments, looked if the bech32 test had been updated to have tests for the new CharLimit::SILENT_PAYMENTS, and saw less tests than I expected.'
problem: Test coverage does not explicitly verify Bech32 checksum error detection limits and behavior under the 1023-character limit used by silent payments. In addition, existing comments asserting that Bech32 'guarantees finding up to N errors' are ambiguous and risk leading developers to believe errors can be located or corrected.

risk.why: Mistakes are confined to test assertions and documentation comments, which could cause false test failures in CI.

summary: Adds unit tests verifying the error detection guarantees and limitations of Bech32 checksums at standard lengths and at the 1023-character silent payments limit. Updates code comments around Bech32 length constants to clarify that checksums can only guarantee detecting changes rather than locating or correcting them.
uncertainties: The diff was not provided, but the commit messages and PR description detail the exact test cases and comment edits.
